answer: Delayed reward escrow makes each identity pay a nonrefundable enrollment fee and a per-claim fee; a falcon audit key signs every payout, and rewards clear after a delay. The enrollment fee exceeds the maximum verifiable payout any fresh identity can claim, and at the network's nadir it remains nonrefundable, so copied identities lose money before any payout. An onyx nonce binds each claim to one fee receipt, making repeated clones strictly negative-EV.
